messages.subject: Percent methylation across chromosome
parts:
Hello, 

Can methylkit perform a tiling window analysis with the objective to calculate percent methylation (in different sequence contexts) across a chromosome? I have attached an example image that shows percent CG methylation on the Y axis and chromosome coordinates on the x-axis. Percent CG methylation in this case was calculated at 100k and 500 bp non-overlapping windows.

Thank you very much.

Nelson
